title: 第392章 天香狐退场？
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“碎！！”

帝狐一字吐出。

迷雾世界剧烈震动，随后竟是寸寸的崩碎开来。

她一刻不想停留了，在漩涡破开的一瞬间，化作一道粉色流光消失在了原地……

香香浑身颤抖不止，虚弱到随时可能倒下。

眼睛已经快要睁不开了。

望着帝狐消失的方向，她没有丝毫松懈，反而脸色大变。

她燃烧体内精血，在意志力的强撑下，拼尽所有速度跟了出去，半空中无数金血洒落。

她脑海中只剩一个念头。

绝不能让她出现在云江仙面前！

绝不允许她伤害云江仙！！

秘境外面。

秦然的心脏狂跳着，已经快要蹦出胸腔。

这种感觉前所未有，他已经可以确定了，秘境中一定发生了大事，关乎生死的大事！

古殿的青铜门突然爆开。

一道熟悉的粉色身影浑身染血，踉跄着疾掠而出，直奔他的方向而来，小脸上写满惊恐与焦急。

“陛下，快救我！！”

秦然瞳孔骤缩，下意识想往前迎。

但，察觉到少女身上气息后，他的脚步猛的一顿，脸上瞬间失去了血色。

小灵儿，不对劲。

脑海中，小云云的声音也及时响起。

“小心，她有问题！”

耽误的这一小会儿，小灵儿的娇躯已经急速扑了过来，距离秦然不足十米远。

秦然屏息而立，大夏龙雀凭空出现在掌心，心中已冰冷一片。

眼看着小灵儿距离越来越近……

古殿门户之后，又有一道身影冲了出来。

香香看见正扑向秦然的小灵儿，顿时目眦欲裂，她美眸中没有丝毫迟疑。

“祭灵秘术——狐尾祭！！”

“狐影闪！！！”

她的身影陡然消失在了原地，化作白色流光掠向了小灵儿。

第七条、第八条狐尾，几乎同时炸开，雄浑的灵力灌入她的体内，她的速度再度提升。

“不够！还不够！！”

“第九尾——狐尾祭！！！”

第九条狐尾中的力量，堪比前八条狐尾的总和。

延迟了一会后，第九条狐尾也随之猛然爆开，气势惊天动地，空间被炸出了道道裂纹。

第九条狐尾爆开后，香香的速度快到近乎瞬移……

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Broken!!"

Emperor Hu spat out one word.

The misty world shook violently, and then collapsed inch by inch.

She didn't want to stay for a moment. The moment the vortex broke, she turned into a pink stream of light and disappeared...

Xiangxiang was shaking all over and was so weak that she might collapse at any time.

I can barely keep my eyes open.

Looking at the direction where the Emperor Fox disappeared, she did not relax at all, but her expression changed drastically.

She burned the essence and blood in her body, and with the support of her willpower, she used all her speed to follow him, and countless golden blood spilled in the air.

There was only one thought left in her mind.

She must not be allowed to appear in front of Yun Jiangxian!

She will never be allowed to harm Yun Jiangxian!!

Outside the secret realm.

Kieran's heart was beating wildly and was about to burst out of his chest.

This feeling was unprecedented, and he was certain that something big must have happened in the secret realm, a matter of life and death!

The bronze door of the ancient palace suddenly exploded.

A familiar pink figure, covered in blood, staggered out and headed straight for him, with fear and anxiety written all over its face.

"Your Majesty, save me quickly!!"

Qin Ran's pupils suddenly shrank, and he subconsciously wanted to move forward to meet him.

However, after noticing the aura on the girl's body, his steps suddenly stopped, and his face instantly lost all color.

Little Linger, something is wrong.

In my mind, Xiao Yunyun's voice also sounded in time.

"Be careful, there's something wrong with her!"

In this short delay, Xiao Ling'er's delicate body rushed over quickly, less than ten meters away from Qin Ran.

Qin Ran stood holding his breath, and the Great Xia Dragon Bird appeared out of thin air in the palm of his hand, his heart was already ice cold.

Seeing Xiao Ling'er getting closer and closer...

Behind the ancient palace portal, another figure rushed out.

When Xiangxiang saw Xiao Ling'er rushing towards Qin Ran, her eyes suddenly burst into tears. There was no hesitation in her beautiful eyes.

"The Secret Technique of Soul Sacrifice——Fox Tail Festival!!"

"Fox Shadow Flash!!!"

Her figure suddenly disappeared from the spot and turned into a white stream of light that swept towards Xiao Ling'er.

The seventh and eighth fox tails exploded almost at the same time, powerful spiritual power poured into her body, and her speed increased again.

"Not enough! Not enough!!"

"Ninth Tails - Foxtail Festival!!!"

The power in the ninth fox tail is comparable to the first eight fox tails combined.

After a delay, the ninth fox tail suddenly exploded with an earth-shattering momentum, and cracks were blown out of the space.

After the ninth fox tail exploded, Xiangxiang's speed was so fast that she almost teleported...
